headline: Hyperscalers charge double or more over neoclouds across all six GPUs, led by H100 SXM at +217%.
bullets: H100 SXM shows the widest hyperscaler premium at +217%, with a hyperscaler median of $12.12 against a neocloud median of $3.82.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $1.83 per PFLOP-hour, and RunPod Community Cloud lists it at a $0.50 median versus a $7.50 hyperscaler median.
B200 carries the top market index at $6.84, with a hyperscaler median of $14.24 and a +109% premium over neoclouds at $6.81.
RunPod Community Cloud is the cheapest provider for five of six GPUs, including H200 at $3.59 against a $4.63 market index.
A100 80GB SXM has the narrowest hyperscaler premium at +100% but the worst price-performance at $7.02 per PFLOP-hour, with Vast.ai cheapest at $1.17.
watch: With only 1 day of history, watch whether the +217% H100 SXM hyperscaler premium holds once a 7-day trend window builds.
